title: Niamh Doyle (NDOYLE)
summary: Warehouse and stores user at Leeds receiving goods receipts into WH-LDS-STR in Ledgerline ERP.
body:
Niamh Doyle (`NDOYLE`) processes goods receipts for Northbridge Cycles at the Leeds stores warehouse (`WH-LDS-STR`)[^r1][^r3]. Operating within Ledgerline ERP, she books inward deliveries of maintenance supplies and production fasteners against active purchase orders[^r1][^r2]. Her recorded transactions appear in the primary 2026 goods receipt registers[^r1][^r3].

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| User ID | NDOYLE |
| Full Name | Niamh Doyle |
| Primary Location | WH-LDS-STR |
| System | Ledgerline ERP 7.2 |

## Goods receipts processed

In January and February 2026, Niamh Doyle entered multiple goods receipt notes into `WH-LDS-STR` across fastener and maintenance categories[^r1][^r2][^r3][^r4]:

* **GRN/2026/28619** (2026-01-12): Received 25 units of fastener `FST-WSH-M4-BK` from supplier `TF-TEL-0287` under purchase order `PO/2026/00012` and delivery note `TF/DN/29155`[^r1][^r3].
* **GRN/2026/28620** (2026-01-15): Received 6 units of maintenance item `MRO-00745` from supplier `GES-GRE-0610` under purchase order `PO/2026/00014` and delivery note `GE/DN/77415`[^r2].
* **GRN/2026/28682** (2026-02-09): Received 135,000 units of fastener `FST-BLT-M5X30-ZN` from supplier `TBN-TAI-0738`[^r4].

Her entry actions are logged in the [[data-grn-register-2026|GRN_register_2026]] transaction sheet and report INV-R030[^r1][^r3].
